fn_company_job_count.definition: SELECT count(*)::integer FROM job_posting WHERE company_id = p_company_id AND status = 'open'

tg_job_posting_set_updated_at.definition: BEGIN NEW.updated_at := now(); RETURN NEW; END

prc_archive_job_posting.definition: BEGIN UPDATE job_posting SET status = 'closed' WHERE status = 'open' AND updated_at < p_before; END
